restated: An adversary with existing access to Windows hosts on this network harvested credentials from those hosts.
what_would_confirm: Evidence of credential theft tooling or artifacts on Windows hosts, such as LSASS process memory access (e.g., procdump, comsvcs.dll MiniDump, Mimikatz), SAM/SECURITY/SYSTEM registry hive or NTDS.dit extraction, DPAPI master key or Credential Manager access, cached domain credential dumping, or suspicious access to browser/credential stores, correlated with adversary process lineage.
what_would_refute: No credential-dumping tool execution, no LSASS handle access by non-standard processes, no registry hive or NTDS.dit copies, no DPAPI or Credential Manager access, and no credential-store reads on the compromised Windows hosts.
